column1: # jespersen's own Slovenian word list (CC0): words respelt for what the spelling rules would miss.
# One per line: the word in lower case, a tab, its respelling. ə is a schwa the rules would not
# find. An accented vowel is stressed, written as Slovenian dictionaries write it: á, é, í, ó and
# ú long and closed, ê and ô long and open, è and ò short. The rules stress the last syllable but
# one and close e and o.
